| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Dehazed image | Dehazed image, Transmission, Dark channel | The dehazed image, the refined transmission t from 0 (all haze) to 1 (no haze), or the dark channel of the input. |
| **Patch size** `patch` | 15 | 3 to 51 px | The side of the square patch of the minimum filter in the dark channel. The paper uses 15. |
| **Haze kept away** `omega` | 0.95 | 0.5 to 1 | The share of the haze that is removed. The paper uses 0.95, so a little haze stays for depth. |
| **Guided filter radius** `radius` | 30 | 1 to 100 px | The radius of the box windows of the guided filter that refines the transmission. |
| **Guided filter eps** `eps` | 0.001 | 1e-05 to 0.1 | The regularization of the guided filter, for values from 0 to 1. |
| **Lowest transmission** `t0` | 0.1 | 0.01 to 0.5 | The transmission is never taken below this value, as in the paper, so thick haze does not blow up noise. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
